Crypto payment: Wallet address identifies the on-chain destination
A blockchain transfer normally cannot be reversed

Traditional payment: One or a few banks may hold the funds
Crypto payment: Assets may move across chains, bridges, mixers, wallets, and exchanges

Traditional payment: Identity is usually available at the bank
Crypto payment: Identity may be available only when funds touch a regulated VASP
Recovery usually requires freezing assets at a VASP or obtaining control through legal process
